csvschema: Self-Describing CSV Files with Embedded, Loss-Tolerant Schemas

Source: R/csvschema-package.R
csvschema-package.Rd

csvschema writes and reads CSV files that carry their own schema inside ordinary data columns, so the file opens as a plain CSV in every tool and the schema survives sorting, filtering, row loss, encoding changes, and spreadsheet round-trips. The name is the joke: the file looks schemaless and is not.

Details

The package does four things:

  1. Packetize a table schema into short ASCII tokens spread redundantly through one or more _schema columns.

  2. Recover the schema from any surviving subset of rows, verify it, and apply it on read.

  3. Canary the data: store fragile sample values per variable in a _canary column and detect, after a round-trip, whether each variable is still intact and how it was damaged.

  4. Point to an optional Frictionless datapackage.json sidecar and cross-check hashes in both directions.

All exported functions use the cs_ prefix.
